scope: S20 design and development validation; formal A/D/B/C execution belongs to later authorized steps.

findings.title: 候选前缀未验证是否仅由送达帧和受权内生演进产生
findings.observation: The restored candidate prefix is checked against the anchor root and ordinary scoped physical/causal checks, but its post-root world facts are not checked against the authorized observation evolution.
findings.reproduction: A candidate from a delivered 0h frame was extended to 0.75h and given an R1 FAILURE absent from the frame and actual run. Its candidate audit passed; adding this unused candidate to the saved evidence also passed the complete saved projection audit (5 frames, 10 decisions, 3 candidates).
findings.impact: The certificate does not establish the claimed exclusion of undelivered exogenous facts from every candidate. The demonstrated injected candidate was not actually dispatched; this does not establish leakage in the original runs or unsafe actual execution.
findings.remedy: Rebuild or validate every candidate prefix from its delivered frame, declared clock, authorized endogenous advance and permitted own nominal decisions; reject new unobserved FAILURE/REPAIR/ARRIVAL/QUALITY facts and bind the recorded model observation digest.

findings.title: 空采样帧集合绕过公共采样完整性及参数核验
findings.observation: The frame loop checks only supplied entries and never requires coverage of the public grid; the UNKNOWN branch infers absence of delivered packets from that potentially empty supplied list.
findings.reproduction: Removing all 5 frames from the original 1h full-loss development record still returned PASS. Changing missing_probability from 1 to 0 in that empty-frame evidence also returned PASS, despite five WAIT_UNKNOWN decisions and a zero-delay zero-loss configuration.
findings.impact: Lost evidence can be accepted as genuine packet loss, and a zero-loss case can be falsely certified as having no delivered observations. This undermines B packet counts and UNKNOWN/availability attribution.
findings.remedy: Validate settings before any frame loop, require all expected public sample ordinals up to the actual end (with explicit early-stop semantics), and distinguish a recorded dropped packet from a missing evidence entry.

findings.title: 保存方法标签未与候选固定模式及冻结方法行绑定
findings.observation: The saved method is copied into a namespace and only distinguishes NO_OBSERVATION_UPDATE from all other strings. Candidate fixed_mode is separately accepted from its saved field.
findings.reproduction: Changing only the ADAPTIVE_JOINT saved record method to FIXED_HR, while both candidates retained fixed_mode=None, returned PASS. NOT_A_REGISTERED_METHOD also returned PASS.
findings.impact: A physically valid adaptive run can be mislabeled as a fixed-method result while preserving a projection PASS; the current audit alone cannot certify method identity for B comparisons.
findings.remedy: Validate the method enumeration and bind method/settings/objective and candidate fixed_mode to a separately trusted frozen manifest row; verify own-anchor semantics for the no-update method.

supplementary_probe_interpretation.over_budget: Projection PASS alone is not budget eligibility. Protocol already separates budget overrun from physical audit; this is not counted as another independent production defect. Future result consumers must separately classify budget compliance.
supplementary_probe_interpretation.alter_model_observation_digest: Recorded digest is currently unused by the saved checker; addressed by the source/evolution binding concern in S20-AUDIT-01, not counted twice.
supplementary_probe_interpretation.remove_terminal_frame: Rejected; retained as a negative control showing that deleting a referenced frame is detected.

recommendation: Close the three B projection evidence defects with a versioned limited repair and targeted positive/negative verification before using B projection PASS as formal comparative evidence. Preserve original acceptance, artifacts, failure records and tags.
